hero.prompt: A wide June twilight: Jupiter's amber-gold tide floods low across a calm Cancer water-horizon, many soft tidal ripples catching the light under one deep indigo-to-near-black canopy that fades from #16112c into #0b0a1b. Soft gold accents in #d4af6a glint along the waterline; a faint teal-and-gold nebula wash drifts high in the sky, evoking a quiet group-stage Cancer season of many tides under a single sky. Painterly editorial illustration, atmospheric and symbolic, full-bleed wide 16:9 that fills the frame. ONE single continuous landscape scene, no split screen, no diptych, no two panels, no diagram, no chart wheel, no central framed card, no text or letters or numerals, no human faces
